schema: source repository + original path -> final destination path(s)
file_level_map: audit/file-map.json (every tracked file of every source)

transforms.why: Upstream runs the detector from the claude-mem repo root (`bun run scripts/anti-pattern-test/...`). Relocated into its own plugin, the script path now uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; it still scans ./src of the current project as upstream does. A frontmatter description was added (upstream has none, so the command had no description in Claude Code's command list). No other change.
Frontmatter name `VibeSec-Skill` contains uppercase letters, which the Agent Skills name rule (lowercase, digits, hyphens; must match the directory) rejects. Renamed to `vibesec`. Body unchanged.

overlap_policy: Overlapping skills from different sources are ALL retained and loadable. Routing precedence for each topic is defined in registry/routing-rules.json; alternatives stay available by explicit invocation.
